With Eye mode on, its camera results are read frame by frame in memory: is someone looking, are the eyes closed and, with a calibrated gaze, where on the page. No frame is kept or sent. From them only counters are stored: seconds the camera watched a page, seconds your eyes were off it, second passes and drift marks. Stays on this phone. This feature never turns the camera on.
